data.description: Whether players are wished a good night when they join.

meta.notes: A game rule of the mod's own: a world setting that is on or off, on in a new world, listed under Chat in the game rule screen and set with /gamerule msm_examples:night_greeting. It is saved with each world. A rule reads it with "The game rule is" and changes it with "Set a game rule"; a script with world.gameRule and world.setGameRule.
